key_highlights: RBA signals further rate hikes to cool job market, squeezing household spending and pressuring financials and property sectors
ASX treads water as interest rate fears dominate; tech stocks lead gains post Wall Street surge but broad market cautious
Iron ore downside risk persists amid China rebalancing towards robotics, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
Saudi oil shock and global diesel shortage (Iran/Ukraine) surge Australian fuel prices, hitting transport and consumer sectors
Sydney housing market in 'bloodbath' as elevated rates bite; federal/state governments face debt cliff
Gold and rare earths miners (Platina, Dalaroo, Broken Hill, Larvotto) show activity but remain speculative
Jetstar industrial action escalates with fee waivers, impacting Qantas.AX group sentiment
Fed's Barkin flags firming economy and broad-based inflation, complicating global rate trajectory

sectors.trend: Iron ore faces structural downside as China pivots to robotics; gold and rare earths explorers active but unproven. Diesel shortage adds cost pressure.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure from weak iron ore demand. Gold miners (PLA.AX, BHP gold arm) and rare earths (DLR.AX) offer diversification but remain high-risk. Fuel cost inflation squeezes margins.

sectors.trend: RBA rate hikes support NIMs but squeeze household borrowing capacity. Housing 'bloodbath' in Sydney raises NPL concerns. Debt cliff pressures government bond yields.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher rates short-term but face credit risk from property downturn. REITs (GPW.AX, SPG.AX) pressured by elevated discount rates.

sectors.trend: Saudi oil shock and global diesel shortage to 2027 spike fuel costs. Energy prices volatile as US political dynamics (Democrat sweep) create uncertainty.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX face input cost pressure. Jetstar (JLH.AX) industrial action adds operational risk. Fuel price surge hits consumer discretionary.

sectors.trend: Tech stocks lead ASX higher post Wall Street surge. China's robotics pivot creates opportunity. Data centre build-out strains net zero targets.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (WES.AX, XRO.AX, CAR.AX) benefit from global tech momentum. China robotics theme (48) may lift Australian automation suppliers.

sectors.trend: Defensive sectors relatively insulated but household spending squeeze from RBA hikes limits discretionary spend. Jetstar action impacts travel.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX offer relative safety. Consumer staples resilient but volume growth constrained by rate-driven spending cuts.

key_themes: RBA tightening cycle: rate hikes to cool labour market, squeezing household budgets and property
Commodity stress: iron ore downside, diesel shortage, oil volatility from geopolitical shocks
China structural shift: rebalancing to robotics, weakening traditional commodity demand
Housing correction: Sydney 'bloodbath' signals broader property risk across ASX
Fiscal risk: federal/state debt cliff threatens sovereign credit and bond markets
Industrial action: Jetstar fee waivers signal broader labour tensions in transport
Global policy divergence: Fed firming vs RBA hiking creates AUD pressure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike cycle extending, compressing household spending and property valuations
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight defensive sectors (CSL.AX, WES.AX); reduce property/REIT exposure; monitor RBA statements for pause signals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand erosion from China's robotics pivot
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; diversify into gold and rare earths exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global diesel/oil shortage driving input cost inflation through 2027
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge fuel costs; favour energy producers (WDS.AX, WLE.AX) over consumers; monitor Saudi/Iran developments

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fiscal debt cliff across federal and state governments
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor government bond yields; reduce duration risk; watch for credit rating downgrades

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Jetstar industrial action escalating, broader transport sector labour risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid JLH.AX and Qantas.AX near-term; monitor union negotiations

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US policy intervention on Australia's algorithm law; geopolitical friction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor regulatory developments; limited direct ASX impact but affects tech sector sentiment

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight defensive healthcare and consumer staples amid rate-driven spending squeeze
opportunities.rationale: RBA hikes and housing correction shift investor flow to quality defensive names with stable cash flows

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to gold and rare earths miners as iron ore weakens
opportunities.rationale: China's robotics pivot reduces iron ore demand; gold benefits from rate uncertainty and geopolitical risk; rare earths aligned with China's strategic focus

opportunities.recommendation: Energy producers positioned for sustained oil/diesel premium
opportunities.rationale: Global diesel shortage to 2027 and Saudi oil shock support upstream margins; WDS and WLE benefit from price discovery

opportunities.recommendation: ASX tech names on Wall Street momentum and China robotics theme
opportunities.rationale: Tech led ASX higher; China's robotics rebalancing creates demand for Australian automation and software suppliers

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore-heavy mining exposure (BHP, RIO, FMG)
defensive_moves.rationale: Structural iron ore downside from China's industrial pivot; commodity cycle turning

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim REIT and property exposure ahead of further RBA hikes
defensive_moves.rationale: Sydney housing 'bloodbath' and rising rates pressure valuations; NPL risk building in financials

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid Jetstar and transport names amid industrial action
defensive_moves.rationale: Escalating union disputes with fee waivers signal revenue pressure and operational disruption
RBA hiking while Fed may pause creates divergence; commodity weakness pressures AUD

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound to slightly lower as RBA rate fears and iron ore weakness offset tech strength. Fuel price spike adds inflationary pressure. Expect volatility around RBA communications and US political developments. ^AXJO likely testing support.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Structural shift in China's economy away from iron ore-intensive growth caps mining multiples. Housing correction and fiscal debt cliff constrain domestic demand. However, gold, rare earths, and energy offer thematic upside. A RBA pause in H2 2026 could trigger a relief rally.
key_catalysts: Next RBA board decision and governor commentary on rate path
Iron ore price trajectory and China stimulus/robotics policy updates
Global diesel/oil supply resolution (Iran, Ukraine, Saudi)
Sydney and national housing data (CoreLogic, ABS)
US election dynamics and Democrat sweep impact on energy policy
Federal/state budget and debt management announcements
watch_list: RBA cash rate and governor statements
Brent crude and Australian diesel pump prices
ASX 200 sector rotation (tech vs materials vs financials)
China PMI and robotics investment data
CPI and RBA inflation forecast revisions
